      - name: Verify manifest truth state
        run: |
          node <<'NODE'
          const fs=require('fs');
          const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/recovery/deep-analysis/manifest.json','utf8'));
          if(m.totals.snapshotBranches !== 91) throw new Error('snapshot count mismatch');
          if(!m.stages.preserved || !m.stages.deeplyAnalyzedMachinePass) throw new Error('analysis stages missing');
          if(m.stages.canonicalized || m.stages.tested || m.stages.verified || m.stages.deleteAllowed) throw new Error('premature completion claim');
          if(m.branches.length !== 91) throw new Error('branch report count mismatch');
          for(const b of m.branches) {
            if(!fs.existsSync(b.report)) throw new Error('missing report '+b.report);
            const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(b.report,'utf8'));
            if(r.changedFileCount !== r.files.length) throw new Error('file count mismatch '+b.sourceRef);
          }
          console.log(JSON.stringify(m.totals));
          NODE
      - name: Commit transparent analysis reports
        run: |
          git config user.name 'pantavion-recovery-bot'
          git config user.email 'pantavion-recovery-bot@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add data/recovery/deep-analysis
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'Deep-analysis reports already current.'
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m 'data(recovery): deep-analyze all 91 snapshot branches'
          git push origin "HEAD:${{ github.head_ref }}"",
